event_node_00_prologue.title: Relic: Shattered Gauntlet
event_node_00_prologue.text: You fell on the battlefield. Your armor crushed. You were supposed to die here. Then, a voice offered you a second chance.

event_node_01_grimoire.title: The Sealed Book
event_node_01_grimoire.text: The book pulses with a dark energy. Strange runes glow along the spine. Something awakens in the spiritual realm.

event_book_ponder.title: The Player Wonders
event_book_ponder.text: What does this demon want with me...?

event_forest_inquiry.title: The Runner Questions
event_forest_inquiry.text: What in God's name is this forest...?

event_node_02_skeletons.title: Ambient Lore: Bone Fields Outpost
event_node_02_skeletons.text: Rattling bones rise from the soil! Intruders shall feed the roots of the woods!

event_node_03_void_scribe.title: Ambient Lore: The Void Scribe's Ledger
event_node_03_void_scribe.text: I record what Andras makes. Names, dates, fates. The ledger is never full. There is always room.

event_node_04_void_bloom.title: Discovery: The Void Bloom
event_node_04_void_bloom.text: A flower grows from a crack in the earth ahead — black petals, silver centre. It turns toward you as you pass.

event_node_05_blood_zombie.title: Spoils: Unholy Relics
event_node_05_blood_zombie.text: The Blood Zombie falls. Two dark relics remain: the Bark of the Bleeding Tree and The EYE of Andras.

event_demon_time_unlocked.title: The EYE Awakens
event_demon_time_unlocked.text: The EYE awakens! Demon Time slows the world. Press [A] during Demon Time to strike with unholy precision!

event_node_06_candora_messenger.title: Interaction: Candora's Messenger Altar
event_node_06_candora_messenger.text: Candora sent me to find the runner before he is lost. I may be too late. I am rarely early.

event_node_07_mural.title: Ancient Inscription: The Scratched Mural
event_node_07_mural.text: A half-collapsed stone mural showing a figure at a threshold. Deep gouges mark the stone where a face once was.

event_node_08_previous_runner.title: Encounter: The Fallen Runner's Warning
event_node_08_previous_runner.text: A wandering shade recognizes your mark: 'I thought it made me stronger. I was right. I was also wrong.'

event_node_09_gatekeeper.title: Soul Harvest Quota: 1,000 Souls Reaped
event_node_09_gatekeeper.text: The Gatekeeper's threshold demands concentrated soul essence. Harvest quota achieved: the path unlocks.

event_node_10_void_silence.title: Ambient Lore: The Void Silence
event_node_10_void_silence.text: The world falls utterly silent. For three seconds, footsteps make no sound before reality rushes back in.

event_node_11_wizard.title: Relic: Amalgam Core
event_node_11_wizard.text: The heart of Andras's prototype vessel — human flesh merged with shadow power. A warning of what lies ahead.

event_node_12_blood_altar.title: Soul Harvest Quota: 5,000 Souls Reaped
event_node_12_blood_altar.text: Five thousand souls bound to your blade. The blood tithe is honored, saturating the necrotic sigil.

event_node_13_blood_zombie.title: Item Discovery: The Blood Brand
event_node_13_blood_zombie.text: Unearthed from the ash of the high crypts. Infuses strikes with leeching crimson fire.

event_node_14_voragis_shrine.title: Relic: Vial of Void Blood
event_node_14_voragis_shrine.text: A vial left by one who walked this path before. A stark reminder that reliance on the power tightens the grip.

event_node_15_dark_ronin.title: Level Complete: Act I Extraction
event_node_15_dark_ronin.text: You have breached the outer perimeter of the Obsidian Citadel. The undead horde falters as dawn approaches.
